claims.name: CapdagCli.answers_end
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (s : CapdagCli.Stage),
  CapdagCli.resolveC c w o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s →
    s ≠ CapdagCli.Stage.provider →
      ∀ (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
        Prod.Lex (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) (fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) (CapdagCli.openness w (CapdagCli.give w l s a))
          (CapdagCli.openness w l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.canAsk_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
  t.canAsk = true ↔ t.reachable = true ∧ t.noInput = false ∧ t.json = false ∧ t.ci = false ∧ t.dumb = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.cli_exit_usage_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (v : CapdagCli.CliVerdict),
  v.exit = some 2 ↔ (∃ r, v = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused r) ∨ ∃ u, v = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is u ∧ u.exit = some 2

claims.name: CapdagCli.cli_fits
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (inv : CapdagCli.Invocation) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  CapdagCli.cli w inv = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is v → CapdagCli.Fits w v

claims.name: CapdagCli.cli_refusal_says
claims.statement: ∀ (r : CapdagCli.CliRefusal), r.says ≠ ""

claims.name: CapdagCli.commandTable_well_named
claims.statement:
(List.map (fun x => x.fst) CapdagCli.commandTable).Nodup ∧
  CapdagCli.globalFlags.Nodup ∧
    (CapdagCli.commandTable.all fun x =>
          match x with
          | (fst, flags) => decide flags.Nodup && flags.all fun f => !CapdagCli.globalFlags.contains f) =
        true ∧
      (CapdagCli.hiddenCommands.all fun c => (List.map (fun x => x.fst) CapdagCli.commandTable).contains c) = true ∧
        (CapdagCli.commandAliases.all fun x =>
              match x with
              | (fst, c) => (List.map (fun x => x.fst) CapdagCli.commandTable).contains c) =
            true ∧
          (CapdagCli.shortFlags.all fun x =>
              match x with
              | (fst, long) =>
                CapdagCli.globalFlags.contains long ||
                  CapdagCli.commandTable.any fun x =>
                    match x with
                    | (fst, flags) => flags.contains long) =
            true

claims.name: CapdagCli.command_fits
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  CapdagCli.command w g c = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is v → CapdagCli.Fits w v

claims.name: CapdagCli.decide_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (s : CapdagCli.Stage) (c : CapdagCli.Choices) (then_ : CapdagCli.CliVerdict),
  c = CapdagCli.Choices.one ∧ CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = then_ ∨
    (c = CapdagCli.Choices.many ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.free) ∧
        w.canAsk = true ∧ CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s) ∨
      (c = CapdagCli.Choices.many ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.free) ∧
          w.canAsk = false ∧ CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.names s) ∨
        c = CapdagCli.Choices.taken ∧
            CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨
          c = CapdagCli.Choices.none ∧
            CapdagCli.decide_ w s c then_ = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is (CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s)

claims.name: CapdagCli.exit_declined
claims.statement: CapdagCli.Verdict.declined.exit = some 130

claims.name: CapdagCli.exit_usage_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  v.exit = some 2 ↔
    (∃ r, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r) ∨
      (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s) ∨ (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.helpUsage

claims.name: CapdagCli.failure_before_question
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  w.resolves m.base = true →
    w.output ≠ CapdagCli.OutputDir.unwritable →
      CapdagCli.firstFailure c (CapdagCli.fixedStages w m l) = some v →
        CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = v ∧ ∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstFailure_at
claims.statement: ∀ (a b : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry), CapdagCli.firstFailure b l = CapdagCli.firstFailure a l

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstFailure_none_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry),
  CapdagCli.firstFailure canAsk l = none ↔
    ∀ (e : CapdagCli.Entry), e ∈ l → (CapdagCli.settle e.snd.fst canAsk e.snd.snd).fails = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstFailure_some
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  CapdagCli.firstFailure canAsk l = some v → ∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_at
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry),
  CapdagCli.firstStop b l = Option.map (CapdagCli.Verdict.at b) (CapdagCli.firstStop a l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_none_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry),
  CapdagCli.firstStop canAsk l = none ↔
    ∀ (e : CapdagCli.Entry), e ∈ l → (CapdagCli.settle e.snd.fst canAsk e.snd.snd).ok = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.firstStop_some
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (l : List CapdagCli.Entry) (v : CapdagCli.Verdict),
  CapdagCli.firstStop canAsk l = some v →
    ∃ s,
      v = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s ∧ canAsk = true ∨
        v = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s ∧ canAsk = false ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s ∨ v = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.freeze_progress
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m → CapdagCli.progress w m (CapdagCli.freeze w l) ≤ CapdagCli.progress w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_input_progress
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (j : Nat),
      j ∈ CapdagCli.missing w m l →
        ∀ (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
          CapdagCli.progress w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l (CapdagCli.Stage.input j) a) < CapdagCli.progress w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_input_settles
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (j : Nat) (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
  ¬j ∈ CapdagCli.missing w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l (CapdagCli.Stage.input j) a)

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_keeps_settled
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (s : CapdagCli.Stage) (a : CapdagCli.Answer) (x : Nat × CapdagCli.Value),
      x ∈ l.named ++ CapdagCli.frozen w m l → x ∈ (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l s a).named

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_option_progress
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (j : Nat),
      j ∈ CapdagCli.openOptions w m l →
        ∀ (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
          CapdagCli.progress w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l (CapdagCli.Stage.option j) a) < CapdagCli.progress w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_option_settles
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (j : Nat) (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
      ¬j ∈ CapdagCli.openOptions w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l (CapdagCli.Stage.option j) a)

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_path_progress
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (p : Nat),
      CapdagCli.Positional.path p ∈ l.inputs →
        CapdagCli.only (CapdagCli.pathCandidates w m l p) = none →
          ∀ (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
            CapdagCli.progress w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l (CapdagCli.Stage.path p) a) < CapdagCli.progress w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.give_stdin_progress
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    CapdagCli.Positional.stdin ∈ l.inputs →
      CapdagCli.stdinBound w m l = [] →
        ∀ (a : CapdagCli.Answer),
          CapdagCli.progress w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l CapdagCli.Stage.stdin a) < CapdagCli.progress w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.globalRefusal_first
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command) (r : CapdagCli.CliRefusal),
  CapdagCli.globalRefusal w g c.fetches c.readsFabric = some r →
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g c) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused r

claims.name: CapdagCli.help_command
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (known : Bool),
  CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpCommand known) =
    if known = true then CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.help
    else CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.noSuchCommand

claims.name: CapdagCli.help_runs_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (t : CapdagCli.HelpTopic),
  CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpFlag t) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.help ∨
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpFlag t) =
        CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused (CapdagCli.CliRefusal.line CapdagCli.Refusal.noSuchMachine) ∨
      CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.helpFlag t) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.unresolved

claims.name: CapdagCli.live_misfit_fails
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  w.resolves m.base = true →
    w.output ≠ CapdagCli.OutputDir.unwritable →
      ∀ (jr : Nat × Nat),
        jr ∈ l.livesNamed →
          (w.liveFit m.base jr.snd).contains jr.fst = false →
            ∃ s,
              CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s ∨
                CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.live_misfit_said
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  w.resolves m.base = true →
    w.output ≠ CapdagCli.OutputDir.unwritable →
      l.paths = [] →
        ∀ (j r : Nat),
          l.livesNamed = [(j, r)] →
            (w.liveFit m.base r).contains j = false →
              CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing (CapdagCli.Stage.live r)

claims.name: CapdagCli.missing_unresolved_names_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m →
    w.resolves m.base = false →
      ∀ (j : Nat),
        CapdagCli.missingThing w o l ≠ some (CapdagCli.Refusal.noSuchInput j) ∧
          CapdagCli.missingThing w o l ≠ some (CapdagCli.Refusal.noSuchOption j) ∧
            CapdagCli.missingThing w o l ≠ some (CapdagCli.Refusal.optionShared j) ∧
              CapdagCli.missingThing w o l ≠ some CapdagCli.Refusal.offline

claims.name: CapdagCli.nothing_chosen_prints_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (m : CapdagCli.Written),
  l.machine = some m → CapdagCli.openOptions w m l = [] → CapdagCli.printsRerun w l l = false

claims.name: CapdagCli.nothing_named_is_usage
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Group),
  CapdagCli.cli w CapdagCli.Invocation.bare = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.helpUsage ∧
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.group g) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.helpUsage ∧
      (CapdagCli.cli w CapdagCli.Invocation.bare).exit = some 2 ∧
        (CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.group g)).exit = some 2

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofCandidates_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (all left : List Nat),
  (CapdagCli.Choices.ofCandidates all left = CapdagCli.Choices.none ↔ all = []) ∧
    (CapdagCli.Choices.ofCandidates all left = CapdagCli.Choices.taken ↔ all ≠ [] ∧ left = []) ∧
      (CapdagCli.Choices.ofCandidates all left = CapdagCli.Choices.one ↔ all ≠ [] ∧ left.length = 1)

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofCount_one_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (n : Nat), CapdagCli.Choices.ofCount n = CapdagCli.Choices.one ↔ n = 1

claims.name: CapdagCli.ofLine_is
claims.statement: ∀ (u v : CapdagCli.Verdict), CapdagCli.ofLine u = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is v → u = v

claims.name: CapdagCli.offline_fetches_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command),
  g.fabrics.eraseDups.length ≤ 1 →
    g.offline = true →
      c.fetches = true →
        CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g c) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.offline

claims.name: CapdagCli.offline_uncached_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command),
  g.fabrics.eraseDups.length ≤ 1 →
    g.offline = true →
      c.fetches = false →
        c.readsFabric = true →
          w.fabricCached = false →
            CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g c) =
              CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.fabricNotCached

claims.name: CapdagCli.openOptions_closed
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.openOptions w m
      { machine := l.machine, inputs := l.inputs, named := l.named, args := l.args ++ CapdagCli.argsFor w m l,
        targets := l.targets, hasFrom := l.hasFrom, hasSelector := l.hasSelector, selectorReads := l.selectorReads } =
    []

claims.name: CapdagCli.pathCandidates_fit
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (p j : Nat),
  j ∈ CapdagCli.pathCandidates w m l p → j ∈ w.fit m.base p ∧ ¬j ∈ l.liveNamed

claims.name: CapdagCli.plan_fits
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (pw : CapdagCli.World) (saveThere : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.PlanLine),
  CapdagCli.Fits w
    (CapdagCli.planVerdict
      { terminal := w.terminal, fileThere := pw.fileThere, machineFile := pw.machineFile, liveThere := pw.liveThere,
        typesKnown := pw.typesKnown, output := pw.output, resolves := pw.resolves, targets := pw.targets,
        machines := pw.machines, planned := pw.planned, plannedInput := pw.plannedInput, inputs := pw.inputs,
        fit := pw.fit, liveFit := pw.liveFit, options := pw.options, optionShared := pw.optionShared,
        optionChoices := pw.optionChoices, needsCartridge := pw.needsCartridge, providers := pw.providers }
      saveThere l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.plan_never_runs
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (saveThere : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.PlanLine),
  CapdagCli.planVerdict w saveThere l ≠ CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.reachableFor_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (stderrTerminal stdinTerminal controllingTerminal stdinIsData : Bool),
  CapdagCli.reachableFor stderrTerminal stdinTerminal controllingTerminal stdinIsData = true ↔
    stderrTerminal = true ∧ (stdinTerminal = true ∨ controllingTerminal = true ∧ stdinIsData = true)

claims.name: CapdagCli.readArgs_machine_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (separated : Bool) (a : CapdagCli.Arg) (rest : List CapdagCli.Arg),
  (CapdagCli.readArgs separated (a :: rest)).fst.isSome = (a.spelling.isMachine && !separated)

claims.name: CapdagCli.readArgs_separated
claims.statement: ∀ (args : List CapdagCli.Arg), CapdagCli.readArgs true args = (none, List.map CapdagCli.Arg.input args)

claims.name: CapdagCli.refusal_first
claims.statement: ∀ (l : CapdagCli.RunLine), CapdagCli.refusal l = (CapdagCli.refusals l).head?

claims.name: CapdagCli.refusal_says
claims.statement: ∀ (r : CapdagCli.Refusal), r.says ≠ ""

claims.name: CapdagCli.refusals_nil_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.refusals l = [] ↔
    (l.machine.isSome = true ∨ l.inputs ≠ [] ∨ l.named ≠ []) ∧
      (l.machine.isSome = true → l.targets = 0 ∧ l.hasFrom = false ∧ l.positionalLives = []) ∧
        (l.hasFrom = true → l.stdinCount ≠ 0) ∧
          l.stdinCount ≤ 1 ∧
            (l.machine.isNone = true → l.named = [] ∧ l.args = []) ∧
              l.liveSharesInput = false ∧ (l.hasSelector = true → l.lives.length = 1 ∧ l.selectorReads = true)

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_asks_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (t : CapdagCli.Terminal),
  CapdagCli.resolve w o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
    CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) o (CapdagCli.rerun w l) = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_rerun
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine), CapdagCli.rerun w (CapdagCli.rerun w l) = CapdagCli.rerun w l

claims.name: CapdagCli.rerun_written
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine), (CapdagCli.rerun w l).machine.isSome = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolveC_at
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.resolveC b w o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.at b (CapdagCli.resolveC a w o l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolveC_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  have v := CapdagCli.resolveC c w o l;
  (∃ r, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r) ∨
    v = CapdagCli.Verdict.unresolved ∨
      v = CapdagCli.Verdict.outputUnwritable ∨
        v = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ∨
          (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s ∧ c = true) ∨
            (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s ∧ c = false) ∨
              (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨ ∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolveC_fits
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (rw : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.Fits w (CapdagCli.resolveC w.canAsk rw o l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_at
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (t : CapdagCli.Terminal) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.at t.canAsk (CapdagCli.resolve w o l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (r : CapdagCli.Refusal),
  CapdagCli.refusal l = some r → CapdagCli.resolve w o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.refused r

claims.name: CapdagCli.resolve_runs_any_terminal
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (t : CapdagCli.Terminal) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.resolve (w.at t) o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ↔ CapdagCli.resolve w o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs

claims.name: CapdagCli.runs_bound_by_name
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (o : Bool) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.resolveC c w o l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs → (CapdagCli.freeze w (CapdagCli.RunLine.written w l)).inputs = []

claims.name: CapdagCli.runs_only_run
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (inv : CapdagCli.Invocation),
  CapdagCli.cli w inv = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
    ∃ g l pf rw, inv = CapdagCli.Invocation.command g (CapdagCli.Command.run l pf rw)

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_ambiguous
claims.statement:
∀ (canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices),
  c = CapdagCli.Choices.many ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.free →
    CapdagCli.settle false canAsk c = if canAsk = true then CapdagCli.Settled.ask else CapdagCli.Settled.name

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_fails_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (said canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices),
  (CapdagCli.settle said canAsk c).fails = true ↔
    said = false ∧ (c = CapdagCli.Choices.none ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.taken)

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_none
claims.statement: ∀ (canAsk : Bool), CapdagCli.settle false canAsk CapdagCli.Choices.none = CapdagCli.Settled.nothing

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_ok_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (said canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices),
  (CapdagCli.settle said canAsk c).ok = true ↔ said = true ∨ c = CapdagCli.Choices.one

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_said
claims.statement: ∀ (canAsk : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices), CapdagCli.settle true canAsk c = CapdagCli.Settled.given

claims.name: CapdagCli.settle_taken
claims.statement: ∀ (canAsk : Bool), CapdagCli.settle false canAsk CapdagCli.Choices.taken = CapdagCli.Settled.extra

claims.name: CapdagCli.stdinCandidates_open
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (j : Nat),
  j ∈ CapdagCli.stdinCandidates w m l →
    j < w.inputs m.base ∧ ¬j ∈ l.namedInputs ∧ ∀ (p : Nat), p ∈ l.paths → ¬j ∈ w.fit m.base p

claims.name: CapdagCli.stopOf_at
claims.statement:
∀ (s : CapdagCli.Stage) (said a b : Bool) (c : CapdagCli.Choices),
  CapdagCli.stopOf s (CapdagCli.settle said b c) =
    Option.map (CapdagCli.Verdict.at b) (CapdagCli.stopOf s (CapdagCli.settle said a c))

claims.name: CapdagCli.two_fabrics_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld) (g : CapdagCli.Globals) (c : CapdagCli.Command),
  g.fabrics.eraseDups.length > 1 →
    CapdagCli.cli w (CapdagCli.Invocation.command g c) = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.refused CapdagCli.CliRefusal.twoFabrics

claims.name: CapdagCli.version_shown
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapdagCli.CliWorld),
  CapdagCli.cli w CapdagCli.Invocation.version = CapdagCli.CliVerdict.is CapdagCli.Verdict.version

claims.name: CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC_at
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC b w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.at b (CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC a w m l)

claims.name: CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  have v := CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l;
  v = CapdagCli.Verdict.unresolved ∨
    v = CapdagCli.Verdict.outputUnwritable ∨
      v = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ∨
        (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s ∧ c = true) ∨
          (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.names s ∧ c = false) ∨
            (∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.extra s) ∨ ∃ s, v = CapdagCli.Verdict.nothing s

claims.name: CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC_runs_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs ↔
    w.resolves m.base = true ∧
      w.output ≠ CapdagCli.OutputDir.unwritable ∧
        CapdagCli.firstFailure c (CapdagCli.fixedStages w m l) = none ∧
          CapdagCli.firstStop c (CapdagCli.machineStages w m l) = none

claims.name: CapdagCli.written_answer_progress
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  l.machine = some m →
    ∀ (s : CapdagCli.Stage),
      CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s →
        s ≠ CapdagCli.Stage.provider →
          ∀ (a : CapdagCli.Answer), CapdagCli.progress w m (CapdagCli.giveWritten w l s a) < CapdagCli.progress w m l

claims.name: CapdagCli.written_asked
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine) (s : CapdagCli.Stage),
  CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.asks s → CapdagCli.Asked w m l s

claims.name: CapdagCli.written_runs_lives_fit
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
    ∀ (jr : Nat × Nat), jr ∈ l.livesNamed → (w.liveFit m.base jr.snd).contains jr.fst = true

claims.name: CapdagCli.written_runs_settled
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (w : CapdagCli.World) (m : CapdagCli.Written) (l : CapdagCli.RunLine),
  CapdagCli.writtenVerdictC c w m l = CapdagCli.Verdict.runs →
    ∀ (e : CapdagCli.Entry), e ∈ CapdagCli.machineStages w m l → e.snd.fst = true ∨ e.snd.snd = CapdagCli.Choices.one
